problem_class.label: nonconvex
problem_class.details: Strict binary separation in bilinear parameters: m(b;(v,a))=a⟨v,b⟩ or m(b;((a₁,a₂),v))=a₁⟨b,v⟩+a₂⟨shift(b),v⟩. The feasible parameter set need not be convex; no scalar minimization objective is specified.

oracle.label: component_gradient
oracle.details: Each oracle call returns the exact parameter gradients of both signed sample margins, ∇θm(D.positive;θ) and −∇θm(D.negative;θ), bundled in one reply. Answers are independent of history and seeds; there is no oracle error or sampling noise.

oracle.label: function_value
oracle.details: The same call also returns both exact signed margins. One budget unit counts this entire joint value-and-gradient reply, rather than each sample evaluation separately.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: Features belong to ℝᵈ with the Euclidean inner product. Parameters belong to ℝᵈ×ℝ or ℝ²×ℝᵈ. Convolution uses a cyclic coordinate shift.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: Exactly two oppositely labeled samples have norms at most radius. The two-layer case requires positive sample inner product and a nonzero orthogonal component. The convolutional case requires a positive constant first sample, positive mean of the second sample, and a nonzero smooth component. Spectral coordinates satisfy first,second≥gain, couplingLower≤coupling≤couplingUpper, and, for convolution, slow≥slowLower. At initialization, with c=coordinates(start) and σ=−sign(c.z), require |c.r+c.y|≤ratio|c.r−c.y|, |c.z|≥depthLower, σ(c.p+c.q)≥wedgeLower, σ(c.p−c.q)≥0, and 2σc.p+2|c.z|≤size. All scalar bounds are positive, couplingLower≤couplingUpper, and ratio≥1. Only model, dimension, radius, and start are public; the remaining bounds are hidden. Allowed algorithms use a fixed positive step, update using the first nonpositive signed margin with priority to the positive sample, and output the current parameter.

accuracy.label: feasibility
accuracy.details: The final output θ must satisfy m(D.positive;θ)>0 and m(D.negative;θ)<0 simultaneously. No epsilon, prescribed positive margin, norm tolerance, or objective-gap criterion is present.

accuracy.label: deterministic
accuracy.details: Separation is required for every combined algorithm/oracle seed, including probability-zero seeds, after execution with the supplied fixed oracle budget.

setup_category.label: non_standard
setup_category.reason: This is a specialized two-example bilinear separation problem with spectral and initialization restrictions, hidden quantitative bounds, a bundled exact oracle, and a prescribed update family. Repository files and local proofs were not inspected. The absence of a qualifying reference is not a novelty claim.
